title: Refuse silent contradictory setup changes
description: Detect contradictory known setup assumptions and route the operator to a distinct setup or explicit recalibration path without mutating assumptions referenced by revisions, profiles, or preparations.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing any known setup field to a different known value is classified as a contradiction with a stable field-specific reason
A contradiction cannot overwrite the existing setup or immutable loading/configuration revisions
The UI offers creation of a distinct setup and labels recalibration as a separate explicit path
Referenced setup assumptions remain unchanged when the action is cancelled or refused

steps.details: Extend setup comparison to return stable machine-readable reasons containing field, prior known value identity, and proposed value identity without physical conclusions.
Reject contradictory in-place writes before IndexedDB mutation and preserve references from loading procedures, configurations, and existing preparations.
Show an accessible explanation with distinct-setup and future recalibration choices; do not present a generic override.
Test every known-field contradiction, cancel flow, distinct setup creation, unchanged references, and reload state.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; implement the contradiction guard through existing comparison and mutation seams.
A recalibration path may be named but cannot claim or derive calibration before evidence-gated later PRDs.
Never silently reinterpret historical profiles or preparations.
